analysis.reason: 직전 3거래일 연속 관망 유지. RSI 49.2로 중립 구간 횡보 지속. ADX 22.0으로 추세 형성 초기 단계 진입. 5일 평균 대비 거래량 비율 0.24로 위축된 움직임. 변동성 ATR 17.94 (5.36%) 감안 시, 현재가 $334.67에서 스윙 지지 $330.50까지 1.24% 하락은 ATR 0.26배 수준으로 손절 폭으로 적합. 스윙 저항 $339.99까지 1.56% 상승은 목표치로 적합. 손익비 1.25로 기준 미달. 따라서 관망 유지.
analysis.reasonEn: The wait-and-see stance has been maintained for the past 3 consecutive trading days. RSI remains in the neutral zone at 49.2. ADX has entered the early trend formation stage at 22.0. Trading volume ratio to the 5-day average is 0.24, indicating subdued activity. Considering the ATR of $17.94 (5.36%), a decline from the current price of $334.67 to the swing support of $330.50 represents a 1.24% drop, equivalent to 0.26x ATR, suitable for a stop-loss. The rise to swing resistance of $339.99 is 1.56%, suitable for a target. The risk-reward ratio is 1.25, below the minimum threshold. Therefore, maintaining a wait-and-see approach.
